name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

slots.name: has_cultivable_land
slots.description: Does the farmer or family own cultivable land in their name?

slots.name: is_institutional_landholder
slots.description: Is the land held in the name of an institution, trust or company?

slots.name: is_govt_employee_or_pensioner
slots.description: Is any family member a serving/retired government officer or receiving monthly pension of ₹10,000 or more (excluding Group D / Class IV)?

slots.name: paid_income_tax
slots.description: Did anyone in the family pay income tax in the last assessment year?

rules.reason: PM-KISAN requires ownership of cultivable agricultural land in the applicant's or family's name.
Institutional landholders, trusts and corporations are excluded from PM-KISAN benefits.
Serving/retired government employees and pensioners with pension ≥ ₹10,000/month (non-Group D) are excluded.
Individuals or family members who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded.

rules.condition: has_cultivable_land == true and is_institutional_landholder == false and is_govt_employee_or_pensioner == false and paid_income_tax == false
rules.reason: You meet all basic eligibility requirements for PM-KISAN as a small/marginal individual landholder farmer.

documents: Aadhaar Card linked with active mobile number
Active Bank Account Passbook with Aadhaar-NPCI DBT seeding
next_steps: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in under 'New Farmer Registration' or visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local Agriculture Office.
